3661-5006-8170-8250.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-8170-8250.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

1306-3698-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-3698-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mana Crypt, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4279-5687-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5687-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-3025-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4311-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

64-1987-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-5223.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

670-1619-6140-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6140-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Cloister Gargoyle to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Cloister Gargoyle enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Cloister Gargoyle trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Cloister Gargoyle until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2511-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3644-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
3644-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Young Wolf.
Young Wolf dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Young Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Young Wolf, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

850-4687-6287.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with defender.
850-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

997-7084-7396.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3967-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
3967-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-3480-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

2781-4605-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5315-6705-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Frog creature token due to Quina.
When the Frog enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Frog.
Repeat from step 2.

2113-4311-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3165-3532-3581-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-3581-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Managorger Hydra trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5231-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5231-5789.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-2438-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4375-5330-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

236-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
236-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
236-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

2105-3967-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3967-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4365-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4365-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4365-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Repeat from step 3.

2-2034-3129-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnomes, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

772-2034-4668-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shade's Form by paying {2}{B}, attaching it to Heliod.
Repeat.

803-2415-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2415-4508.description:
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

1938-1971-2781.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, plus {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
1938-1971-2781.description:
Cast Yannik by paying {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Yannik enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling Felidar Guardian until Yannik leaves the battlefield and triggering the last part of its ability.
Resolve this trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any target creature.
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling Yannik and any number of other non-Angel creatures you control until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield due to Yannik leaving the battlefield, triggering itself, blinking Glorious Protector.
Yannik returns from exile to the battlefield without using the stack due to Glorious Protector leaving the battlefield.
When Yannik and Glorious Protector enter the battlefield, they each trigger themselves.
Resolve Yannik's trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Yannik leaves the battlefield and triggering the last part of its ability.
Resolve this trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any target creature.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Yannik until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6.
